item.title: Stefan Davis Death, DJ Fresh Memorial, Fort Montague
item.ns0:title: Stefan Davis Death, DJ Fresh Memorial, Fort Montague
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, a nation grieves as the body of beloved visual artist Stefan Legend Davis arrives home, while family and friends gather to honor the lasting legacy of DJ Fresh. The Maritime Revenue Unit receives a powerful new patrol vessel to help curb illegal activities at sea, and the United States pledges nearly a quarter-million dollars to restore the historic Fort Montagu. Plus, former politician and businessman David Wallace opens up about his harrowing battle with aggressive thyroid cancer, while we explore the unique struggles facing Family Island artists trying to make it in the music industry. Be sure to tune in for all these stories, your weekend sports roundup, and the full weather forecast.
